limits: Prepared inventory/header/detail publications are observations, never compilation or evidence admission. Complete inputs are validated before separate overview/detail fingerprints; each projection keeps its 64 MiB framing budget. Worker/source/compiler/evidence bounds are unchanged.

Lexical reuse relies on host indexer/source attribution and pure indexer correspondence; those are adapters, not new refinement or evidence authority. Retention bounds count serialized bytes, not exact JavaScript heap usage.
